Then reason: the question states that Jakarta is located at 6°S, and that at this time the shadow of an object at noon points north. A noon shadow pointing north indicates that the sun is located south of Jakarta, that is, the direct solar point is south of Jakarta, and the Southern Hemisphere receives direct sunlight. According to the method given in the question, from this it is judged that L in the figure corresponds to the morning line at point O. Points on the morning line are just at sunrise, and the local time at point O where the morning line intersects the equator is 6 o’clock, so the sunrise time on that day is 6 o’clock.
